title: Recalibrate token scale for dynamic surfaces, charts, and compact controls
creator: Leah Chen
description: Scope: Rework the core design tokens that drive surface density, color palettes, type scale, spacing/radii, and elevation mapping. Goal is to reduce visual noise for compact surfaces (buttons, table rows, chip lists), improve chart legibility at small sizes, and create a predictable elevation model that works consistently across light/dark modes and high-DPI displays. Deliverables: 1) revised color ramps (neutral and semantic) with target contrast ratios; 2) new 4px-based spacing and radius tokens with explicit migration map; 3) fluid typography scale for small-to-medium viewports and clarified token names for headings/body/caps; 4) elevation token set (E0..E5) with CSS variables and shadow presets tuned for accessibility and performance. Impact: This touches component library (buttons, inputs, tables, charts, cards), Console visualizations, and design docs. We expect small visual regressions where density reduces shadow/border prominence—these will be validated by visual diffs and a canary release. Migration approach: codemods to rename deprecated tokens, compatibility aliases for two releases, and a rollout plan: canary -> alpha -> stable. Testing: automated contrast checks (axe + custom rules), Percy visual snapshots for core routes, and chart rendering verification for small tick labels. Stakeholders: Design (tokens team), Frontend (component owners), Docs, QA, Product. Risk: Some legacy product pages may require manual polish after automated swap due to bespoke overrides. Rollout window and deprecation notes included in attachments.
